repos.name: Gaurav-Gosain/tuios
repos.description: A terminal window manager that knows what your agents are doing. Tiling panes, workspaces, sessions that survive restarts, and one Inbox for every coding agent.
repos.one_liner: A terminal window manager designed specifically to orchestrate and monitor multiple coding agents.
bullets: Built in Go with a focus on high-performance terminal session management.
Features tiling panes, persistent workspaces, and session recovery across restarts.
Provides a centralized 'Inbox' to aggregate outputs and status updates from various AI coding agents.
Optimizes developer workflow by unifying fragmented agent interactions into a single interface.

repos.name: dzhng/jevgrep
repos.description: Find code by asking what it does. A CLI for coding agents that uses Jev to discover relevant files and source context.
repos.one_liner: A CLI tool that enables coding agents to perform semantic code discovery and context retrieval.
bullets: TypeScript-based CLI designed to bridge the gap between LLM reasoning and local file system navigation.
Uses the Jev engine to index and search codebases based on functional intent rather than just keyword matching.
Acts as a critical retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) component for autonomous coding agents.
Reduces token waste by providing agents with only the most relevant source context for a specific task.
repos.img_alt: jevgrep — Same intelligence. About 30% lower cost.
repos.img2_alt: Jevgrep workflow: about 30% lower coding-agent cost, with 8 of 10 tasks solved both with and without Jevgrep.

repos.name: oblien/openship
repos.one_liner: A self-hosted deployment platform designed to simplify infrastructure management for modern applications.
bullets: Full-stack deployment solution built with TypeScript for high extensibility.
Provides a self-hosted alternative to managed PaaS providers, offering full control over infrastructure.
Streamlines CI/CD pipelines and environment management for developers and small teams.
Ideal for hosting internal tools, microservices, or staging environments with minimal overhead.

repos.name: aipoch/open-science
repos.description: An open-source, model-agnostic AI workbench for scientific discovery.
repos.one_liner: An open-source, model-agnostic AI workbench tailored for scientific discovery and research workflows.
bullets: TypeScript-based architecture that supports integration with various LLM backends.
Designed to facilitate complex data analysis and hypothesis testing in scientific domains.
Provides a modular workbench environment for researchers to experiment with AI-driven discovery.
Supports reproducible research by standardizing how models interact with scientific datasets.

repos.name: shhivv/taiga-s1
repos.description: Taiga-S1: a 1.2M-parameter System-1 model that builds CAD parts in FreeCAD
repos.one_liner: A compact 1.2M-parameter System-1 model specialized for generating CAD parts in FreeCAD.
bullets: Python-based implementation utilizing a highly efficient, small-scale neural architecture.
Focuses on 'System-1' thinking, prioritizing rapid, intuitive generation over complex reasoning.
Automates the creation of 3D mechanical components directly within the FreeCAD ecosystem.
Demonstrates the potential for specialized, lightweight AI agents in engineering and manufacturing workflows.
